# Direct mail and gift brief

Gifts above the market limit, or to any public-sector or government-linked account, need gate G4. Limits: `markets/rules.json` `gift_limit`.

- Account and recipient: {{account}} / {{name}}, {{role}} (contact_id {{contact_id}})
- Play: {{play_id}} · Send date: {{date}} (arrive on a working day, not on the local weekend)
- Item: {{item}} · Value: {{value}} {{currency}} · Within limit: yes / no · Public sector: yes / no
- Why this item: {{tie_to_their_priority}} (useful, not luxury)
- Note card text (60 words or less): {{note}}
- Address source: business address only. Confirm with the contact before you ship to a home address.
- Follow-up: email S2 step 2 or a call task 3 days after delivery
- Banned: cash and cash-like vouchers for public officials, alcohol and pork products in the GCC, items that break the account's gift policy.
